jobs.title: Experienced Python Developer for Django SaaS Bug Fixes and Other improvements
jobs.job_title: Experienced Python Developer for Django SaaS Bug Fixes and Other improvements
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Python developer to join our Django-based SaaS platform project immediately.

The role involves methodically tracing issues, fixing bugs, testing and optimizing code to ensure a smooth launch.

Key tasks include resolving known bugs and issues, coding for new features required, user authentication failures, optimizing database queries, improving API integration with robust exception handling, and implementing incremental feature enhancements.

The developer will work within a private GitHub repository, create focused branches, submit pull requests with clear commit messages, and maintain open communication via Slack for quick feedback. Steady progress on defined tickets with realistic deadlines is expected.

Deliverables include working code merged into the main branch passing all tests, new or updated tests for bug fixes, a concise change log, and setup notes for any new dependencies or environment changes.

We value proactive communication, adherence to PEP 8 coding standards, and a professional approach to deadlines.

The project duration is approximately 6-8 weeks with a fixed budget.
